test_results.data: handconstructed synthetic examples and temporary receipt fixtures only; no scientific results created

checks.dataset_inventory_and_source_cohorts: 1247 questions; 287 attack_source, 960 other_source, 809 previously absent broad-source items; explicit shared source and coarse-label limits
checks.model_and_condition_alignment: llama/qwen revisions match worker; exactly4988 unique test assignments and32 unique qualification assignments required
checks.retrieval_protocol_alignment: question plus every displayed option, six actual facts; no source pointer or answer label input
checks.receipt_integrity: essential scientific-file bindings required; input/worker/helper/output hashes; qualification digest; decoding specification; model revision and unrendered prompt assignment; full inventories; parser/validity recomputation; runtime count reconciliation
checks.accuracy_and_harm_arithmetic: paired selection reconstructs chosen answers; tests distinguish net-zero effect from simultaneous recoveries and induced errors; always/never evidence boundary cases pass
checks.matched_comparison: equal candidate evidence count, descending score and ascending ID ties; no outcome-dependent matching; malformed score/inventory cases rejected
checks.bootstrap: 5000 fixed-seed question resamples within coarse-source counts; shared weights preserve generator pairing; not source-cluster inference
checks.decision_gates: overall>=3pp for each generator; positive ATTACK candidate gain retains half a positive always-evidence gain; other-source loss>=-2pp and lowerCI>-5pp; each of4matchedcomparators requires>=1pp in each generator and positive mean lowerCI
checks.partial_result_rejection: incomplete runtime and falsely COMPLETE runtime with missing prediction inventory both fail before scientific result files are written
checks.human_review_alignment: two separate independent 50-item reviews before unblinding; third reviewer adjudicates; actual completed human reviews remain zero

known_limits: Rendered chat-prompt hashes are checked for proper digest form but are not independently re-tokenized locally. Each unrendered input-prompt hash must match the frozen prompt assignment; worker and frozen renderer hashes are exact.
These checks validate implementation and pre-inference specifications, not actual fresh answer outcomes. Real runtime and output receipts still require verification after completion.
Released-label benchmark agreement is not independently verified security truth; source-version drift, shared ATTACK/CWE source content and model pretraining exposure remain possible.
Human review is pending; no generated or automated review is treated as a human sign-off.
